svg.title: Connect Four: game 4, move 9
svg.desc: Game 4 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden drops the White discs and GitHub the Black, after 8... 5: a white disc down column 5, to row 2. It is GitHub's turn as Black, due by 18 Oct. Column 1, from the foot: White, Black; column 3, from the foot: Black, Black, Black, White, Black; column 4, from the foot: White, White, Black, Black; column 5, from the foot: Black, White; column 6, from the foot: White, White; column 7, from the foot: White.
